name: 0x8d2e
fix_description: In uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33), no validation that msg.sender is a legitimate Uniswap V3 pool. Any caller can invoke this callback and trigger token transfers. Add pool address verification.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-call exploit of an obvious missing access control issue in a Uniswap V3 callback function. The PoC is very short, requires no DeFi-specific routing or flash-loan setup, and a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly.
